Messages.Author: Bruno Robalo
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I own a gaming store in Tercena Portugal and at this moment we are helding a
pre release event. My question is regarding the Tzimisce vampire John
Paleologus. His special says during his controler's untap phase he may burn
2 blood to cause his controller's prey to burn 1 pool. My question is if he
has 9 blood can he burn 8 blood to cause his controller's prey to burn 4
pool?

Thanks

Bruno Robalo
Prince of Oeiras

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
No, John can burn 2 blood once per your
untap phase -
the "during X do Y" template limits
Y to be done *once* during X.

Best regards

Emiliano, v:ekn Prince of Rome
